title: Planner Agent in Copilot Chat: task assignment, scheduled catch-up and memory
summary: Hold: the controls table reports agent-blocking automation as undocumented, but Microsoft publishes a beta Graph endpoint requiring Microsoft Agent 365 licensing. The notice supports the default-on behaviour, licence requirement and December dates; the pinning path is also documented, including the ellipsis menu.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The general tenant-wide block action is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... In the All agents page, select an agent from the list of agents. ... In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select Block or Unblock.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance controls, first paragraph
claims.claim: No API for the general organisation-wide agent-blocking control is documented.
claims.quote: Block a Copilot package to prevent its usage. ... Access to the Package Management API requires a Microsoft Agent 365 license. ... POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block
claims.fix: Replace the null API with the general beta Graph call POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/admin/catalog/packages/{id}/block and cite this reference. State that it requires Microsoft Agent 365 licensing and delegated CopilotPackages.ReadWrite.All, is not supported for production applications, and is a general package control whose Planner-specific applicability has not been established. Remove the blanket no-block-API wording.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Manage pinned agents is reached through Agents > All agents > ellipsis menu > Manage pinned agents.
claims.quote: select Agents > All Agents > Registry. ... In the All agents page, select the ellipse on the right to display a dropdown menu. ... Select the Manage pinned agents.
claims.fix: Include the Registry tab in the structured and rendered paths: Agents > All agents > Registry > ellipsis menu > Manage pinned agents. The ellipsis step itself is supported; the automatic pre-check's missing-word result is cosmetic.
